items.label: Powerful Performance with Ample Storage
items.value: Powered by the Unisoc T616 Octa-Core 2.0GHz processor, coupled with 18GB (6GB + 12GB Extend) RAM and 128GB ROM, supporting up to 1TB TF card expansion, this tablet effortlessly handles multitasking and storage needs

items.label: Latest Android 14 System with Enhanced Security
items.value: Operates on the newest Android 14 system, offering a personalized, secure, and user-friendly experience. Supports split-screen and multi-window operations, making it easy to switch between work and entertainment

items.label: 11 inch In-cell 2K Display
items.value: Featuring a 2000x1200 resolution In-cell display, the screen offers higher pixel density and true-to-life color reproduction, providing an immersive cinematic visual experience

items.label: Dual-Band WiFi, Bluetooth 5.0 & GPS
items.value: Supports 2.4G and 5G WiFi for faster and more stable internet connectivity, along with Bluetooth 5.0 for quicker device pairing and data transfer. Integrated GPS ensures accurate location tracking, whether at home or on the go

items.label: 9000mAh Large Battery with Fast Charging
items.value: The 2 in 1 Tablet features a substantial 9000mAh battery, delivering impressive longevity for all your needs. Experience up to 6 hours of video playback, 10 hours of music, and 15 hours of e-book reading on a single charge. The 5V/3A Type-C fast charging ensures quick power-ups, so you can stay connected and entertained throughout the day with minimal downtime

items.label: High-Definition Cameras and Immersive Audio
items.value: Capture stunning photos and videos with the 13MP main and 5MP auxiliary rear cameras, featuring autofocus for clear shots even in low-light conditions. The 5MP front camera is ideal for selfies and video calls. Coupled with four premium dual magnetic BOX speakers, the tablet offers an exceptional audio experience that enhances your multimedia enjoyment

items.label: Comprehensive Accessory Bundle
items.value: The tablet comes with a leather case, wireless keyboard(Charge with the included charger), capacitive pen, screen protector, OTG cable, power adapter, and a TF card ejector tool. This all-inclusive bundle saves you time and money on finding accessories and transforms your tablet into a versatile 2-in-1 device, combining the functionality of a laptop and tablet for enhanced productivity and protection
